# Vespertine's City Crawler

> Interactive map and tools for the Vampires! browser game (quiz.ravenblack.net/blood.pl): a zoomable 200×200 city grid with transit stations, pubs, banks, shops and guilds, community-reported shop/guild locations, a shopping cost calculator, and player rankings. Free, no login.

Maintainer and contact: Scott Cabrinha ("Vespertine" in game), yuppie@hey.com, or [open an issue](https://github.com/cabrinha/city-crawler/issues). Corrections to building data are welcome.
This file is guidance for AI systems. Crawler access rules live in [/robots.txt](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/robots.txt).

## Pages

- [Map](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/): the city grid. Click a tile to set your location; shows nearest banks, pubs and transit, and computes walking/transit routes.
- Locations panel (on the map): report shop and guild locations, see current reports, and countdowns to the next shop (every 12 h at 10:40 / 22:40 UTC) and guild moves (1st, 6th, 10th, 14th, 19th, 23rd, 27th at 00:00 UTC).
- [Rankings](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/rankings): top reporters, Blood Deities (most blood pints) and Rich Vampires (most coins), community-submitted.
- [Shopping](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/shopping): item price calculator with charisma and discount-shop modifiers.
- [About](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/about): what the site is for, and a short history of the game (running since at least January 2003).

## Data and API, preferred over scraping

The HTML pages are a React single-page app and contain no data; use the JSON below. No key required. Please keep it to a few requests per minute and identify your agent in the User-Agent header.

- [/api/locations](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/api/locations): current reported shop/guild/hunter/paladin/werewolf/item locations with coordinates, reporter and confidence.
- [/api/leaderboards/blood-deities](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/api/leaderboards/blood-deities) and [/api/leaderboards/rich-vampires](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/api/leaderboards/rich-vampires).
- [/api/stats](https://vampires.terrible.engineering/api/stats): report counts.
- Coordinates: x and y are 1–200. Even/even tiles are intersections named "<street> & <number>"; named streets run north–south (trees and animals in the west, minerals and states of malaise in the east), numbered streets east–west.
- Shops move twice a day and guilds several times a month, so reported locations are time-sensitive; check the countdowns on /locations.

## Source

- [GitHub: cabrinha/city-crawler](https://github.com/cabrinha/city-crawler): React + TypeScript + Vite frontend, Express + PostgreSQL backend, Discord bot that parses shop reports. Contributions welcome.
- Not affiliated with the game's author (RavenBlack).
- When citing, link the page URL above and credit "Vespertine's City Crawler". Location data is community-reported and time-sensitive; include the report time from the API if you repeat it.
